description: This file implements an ApprovalService class for managing submission approvals, including e-signature challenges, approval workflows with state transitions, role-based permissions, and audit logging. It interacts with a database, handles external services for authentication and evidence management, and enforces segregation of duties and signature validity checks.

classes.name: ApprovalError
classes.description: Base exception class for approval-related errors.

classes.name: AuthenticationError
classes.description: Exception for authentication failures, inherits from ApprovalError.

classes.name: AuthorizationError
classes.description: Exception for authorization failures, inherits from ApprovalError.

classes.name: SoDViolationError
classes.description: Exception for segregation of duties violations.

classes.name: InvalidStateError
classes.description: Exception for invalid state transitions in approval workflow.

classes.name: ApprovalService
classes.description: Main class implementing approval workflow with state management, e-signature validation, and audit/logging integrations.

methods.description: Verifies the user's electronic signature credentials, creating a verified signature record if successful.

methods.description: Handles submission approval or rejection, including role validation, signature validation, state transition, audit logging, evidence creation, and precondition checks.
